item_name: Rothco Deluxe Fire Department Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Proudly wear your support for our brave fire fighters with Rothco’s Deluxe Fire Department Low Profile Cap.
description: Proudly wear your support for our brave fire fighters with Rothco’s Deluxe Fire Department Low Profile Cap. The front panel of this fire department cap displays a raised embroidered “FIRE DEPT” with a 3-D classic fire department emblem stitched in the center with impeccable detailing. The words “FIRE DEPT.” are sewn in stark white thread twice on the brim of this fire fighter hat, while the adjustable hook and loop closure on the back of this fire department insignia hat also features the text ‘FIRE DEPT.” “FIRE DEPT.” also appears centered on the front of the brim. Our firefighter logo cap constructed with 100% brushed cotton twill for unparalleled comfort and durability.
